title: Kafsokalyvia skete: Maximus the flying monk who burned his huts

tellings.quote: this is named in in the honor of one of the saints we have here Saint Kaffa so he was known as Maximus the monk. He was not not Otis Maximus and he was known as a flying monk and he burned his huts and he had these miracles and they were sightings of him flying.

plain: Kafsokalyvia is a skete, a small monks' settlement, on Mount Athos in Greece, and it is named for a saint remembered as Maximus, a "flying monk" who burned his huts, worked miracles and was seen flying. A visitor named Ralph Larson tells this from what a young monk who looked after the skete told him during his trip there in 2005. It is told as local lore of a holy man who could fly.
